objective: Evaluate modification correctness and integration burden when roles, exceptions, evidence dependencies and policy versions change in a small decision workflow; not equal-rule output accuracy as the primary research contribution.
current_tick: Offline design and independent review only. No application, paid model calls, historical replay or policy change executed.

grounding.candidate: Existing repository research-review workflow, used only as an offline shadow example; do not change live reviewer gates, request caps or approval rules.
grounding.observed: RUNBOOK requires separate methods and implementation reviewers; research_ops.evidence_for rejects review blockers and requires registered checks before analysis.
grounding.limitation: This is an engineering case study in this repository, not manufacturing/finance transfer or representative agent deployment.

flow: Versioned objects, role assignments, policy and dependency snapshot
Decision plus explanation and affected review IDs
Host rechecks snapshot before any real execution
architecture.agent: Future LLM may interpret proposed changes and select lookups; interpretation errors are separately scored. Current study design authorizes no new model execution.

graph_roles.evidence: Which immutable review relied on which snapshot

architecture.scope: Shadow evaluation only; no actual approval or execution. No UI or full platform required in this phase.

arms.name: Explicit Python policies over indexed JSON
arms.strength: Shared policy functions and indexed relationships; no duplicated configuration straw baseline.

arms.name: Declarative JSON policy and dependency model
arms.strength: Generic evaluator with versioned rules, roles and relation definitions; same information and explanatory output.

arms.name: Declarative RDF model with SHACL and explicit traversal
arms.strength: Same rules and supplied relations as B; SHACL validates stated conditions, traversal identifies dependencies; no automatic business truth or scheduler inferred.

attribution: A versus B tests policy/model externalization as a package; B versus C tests representation/tooling within a matched semantic envelope. Do not attribute A-C differences to RDF alone. Any unsupported construct is recorded; do not silently reduce expressiveness.

change_tasks.change: Require an additional data-steward review for jobs marked data-changing.
expected_invariants: Only explicitly data-changing jobs require the extra role
Existing independent reviewer and blocker gates still hold
Absent classification yields unknown, not implicit exemption
change_tasks.negative_control: Non-data-changing job needs no extra role.

change_tasks.change: Allow a named formatting check to be omitted for explicitly documentation-only jobs under a new policy version.
expected_invariants: No reviewer blocker can be waived
No omission for mixed or unclassified jobs
Every exception cites its policy version and reason
change_tasks.negative_control: A failing non-formatting check remains blocking.

change_tasks.change: Replace one declared input artifact used by multiple reviews.
expected_invariants: Only reviews transitively dependent on the changed artifact become stale
Cycles terminate; versioned nodes and visited-set semantics are specified before implementation
change_tasks.negative_control: Unreferenced artifact change does not stale a review.

change_tasks.change: Evaluate an old review with its original policy, then assess eligibility under a new policy.
expected_invariants: Current eligibility is a new decision with a different policy ID
Equivalent rule content with a different ID still follows declared version binding unless migration explicitly approved
change_tasks.negative_control: Unchanged policy and snapshot reproduces the stored decision.

procedure: Before coding, freeze a small shared abstract rule language, supported operations, typed identifiers, unknown precedence, override policy and temporal/dependency semantics for all arms.
Build baseline implementations and record initial setup/mapping effort separately from change effort. Implement no baseline with advance task-specific shortcuts.

For each task fork the same baseline; record first attempt before repairs and all later diffs. Shared-evidence task additionally has a separately labelled sequential update trace with duplicate/out-of-order events.

Freeze expected invariant tests from the public contract, reviewed independently of implementing agents. They are authored software expectations, not held-out real-world gold; runtime receives no expectation labels.

Use isolated native implementation contexts for future trials, counterbalance arm order and log context visibility. Reusing the same operator/tasks creates learning effects; do not claim a controlled human study.
Run matched semantic and negative-control checks; preserve all failures. Request a new execution review after implementations exist.

primary: Unintended changed decisions on unaffected inputs
Missed affected reviews and unnecessary rechecks
Correct separation of historical decision and current eligibility
Policy change implemented without hidden host-code bypass
engineering: Files and logical components modified, split evaluator/adapter/model/policy/tests
Actual editing and verification time with interruptions labelled
measures.limits: Line counts, agent turns and wall time are descriptive engineering traces, not direct human productivity or general maintainability measures. Equal outcomes are a prerequisite, not the novelty claim.

failure_taxonomy: Host execution race (not exercised by shadow probe)

decision_gate.continue: Demonstrable reusable rules or traceable changes across tasks with acceptable setup burden; report counterexamples and implementation asymmetries.
decision_gate.stop_new_library: If competent declarative JSON handles changes equally clearly with lower integration burden, retain tests and adapters as contributions rather than launch a new framework.
decision_gate.dynamic_ontology: Later propose model changes from observed unmapped concepts; separate proposal, review and accepted version. Do not let automatically proposed relations establish complete evidence coverage.

next_bounded_step: Specify the shared policy and dependency contract with one real source-field mapping from the existing review ledger; offline read-only shadow export, excluding secrets and raw model answers. No live rule migration.
authorization: No paid API, infrastructure, databases, scheduling changes, live gates or remote publication.
